result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal content is visibly clipped and the fixed bottom navigation obscures part of the next restaurant card.

issues.description: The category chip row overflows the viewport: the next chip is only partially visible on the right edge.
issues.suggestion: Contain the horizontal carousel within the layout, add deliberate horizontal scrolling behavior and spacing, or ensure the final visible chip is not awkwardly clipped.

issues.description: The restaurant carousel extends beyond the right edge, leaving the third card and its title visibly cut off.
issues.suggestion: Use a properly implemented horizontal carousel with consistent card widths, intentional peeking, and no truncated text unless the clipping is clearly part of the interaction design.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the second restaurant card, hiding its lower content and making the page appear cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding to the scrollable content or adjust the navigation overlay so the full card can be viewed above it.
